title: Door kiosk
presentCount: {count, plural, =0 {No children present} one {# child present} other {# children present}}

children.prompt: Enter the child's code or the parent's PIN

scan.prompt: Hold the QR code up to the camera

errors.denied: Camera access was refused. Allow the camera for this site, or use the keypad.
errors.noCamera: No camera was found on this device. Use the keypad.
errors.insecure: The camera needs a secure connection (HTTPS). Use the keypad.
errors.generic: The camera could not start. Try again or use the keypad.

verify.subtitle: Check that the photo matches the person in front of you before recording.
verify.noPhoto: No photo on file — check an ID before releasing a child.
verify.confirmCount: {count, plural, =0 {Choose a child} one {Record # child} other {Record # children}}

duplicate.title: Check before recording

reasons.already_in: {name} is already checked in and still here. Nothing has been recorded.
reasons.already_out: {name} was already checked out today. Nothing has been recorded.
reasons.just_arrived: {name} arrived less than two minutes ago. Did you mean to record a departure?
reasons.returned: {name} left today and is now back at the door. Record their return?

duplicate.partial: {recorded} of {total} recorded. This child is waiting on your decision.
duplicate.remaining: {count, plural, one {# more child to check} other {# more children to check}}
duplicate.forceReturn: Record return — the earlier departure will be replaced

result.noGuardian: No adult was identified for this scan.
result.partialFailure: {count, plural, one {# child could not be recorded} other {# children could not be recorded}}

staff.prompt: Enter your staff code or PIN
staff.unpaidNote: Breaks are not counted as paid hours.
staff.allowanceNote: Lunch is paid up to {minutes} min. Anything beyond that is unpaid.

errors.unknownCode: Unknown code. Check the code and try again.
errors.ambiguousCode: This code matches more than one person. Ask the office.
errors.noChildren: No enrolled child is linked to this code.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.loadDescription: An error occurred. Check the connection and try again.
errors.pickupNotAllowed: This adult is not authorized to pick up this child. Nothing was recorded — see the director.
errors.alreadyClockedIn: You are already clocked in today.
errors.alreadyOnBreak: You are already on a break.
errors.staffCodeHere: That is a staff badge. Use the Personnel tab.
